GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 386.3 (22 Apr 48) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN - 1880/2)
APO 500
1 March 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Procedures for Restoration to Nationals of the United Nations of Property under Procurement Demand.
1. Reference is made to the following memoranda for the Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers:
a. File AG 091.112 (13 Sep 45)MG, SCAPIN 26, 13 September 1945, subject, "Protection of Allied and Axis Property"
b. File AG 600.3 (30 Nov 46)CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1370, 30 November 1946, subject, "Preservation of Property in Japan Owned by United Nations and Their Nationals"
c. File AG 386.3 (22 Apr 48)CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1880, 22 April 1948, subject, "Procedures for Restoration of Property in Japan to Nationals of the United Nations. "
2. The Japanese Government is hereby notified that the following procedures will govern restorations, under the terms of reference 1c above, of properties which are under Procurement Demand by the Occupation Forces:
a. Restoration of title will be effected immediately upon issuance by General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers of a directive ordering restoration of property and a report will be submitted promptly upon completion of registration of title.
b. Restoration of vacant possession will be effected after release from Procurement Demand.
c. The execution of the final restoration receipt and the signing at the agreed statement as to the extent and condition of the. property being returned will not be effected until physical possession of the property has been completed.
3. The Japanese Government is hereby notified that it is responsible for the protection, maintenance and preservation under the terms of references 1a and 1b above of United Nations property subject to restoration until such time as transfer of both title and possession has been effected to the United Nations national restoree.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
